scope: Independent bounded review of the exact R6 assembled production/test sources against the R5 sources and the R6 assembly record. The comparison was read-only. A fresh focused R6 replay was run only in an isolated temporary directory with the assembled source; no CODE product path was written.

production.operation: Every changed production line is one of the 29 pinned direct CodeProofResourceError/CodeProofStructureError raises in the seven authorized definitions, adding exactly `from None`; no other production line changed.
production.original_defect: The R5 29 private direct raises could inherit unrelated active exception context. R6 suppresses that context without changing error type, reason or control flow.

tests.operation: The R6 test prefix is exactly the R5 test source after the 48 named helper calls change from exc to exc.value and the one profile lookup changes from mutated["inventory"][0] to mutated["schemas"][0]. The sole appended top-level function is test_private_errors_suppress_outer_exception_context(resources), has no decorator and one resources parameter; its pinned size/SHA match assembly-r6.json.
tests.original_defects: The pytest ExceptionInfo/value mismatch and the stale inventory profile lookup are closed with only the authorized replacements.

outer_context_probe.coverage: The test creates active RuntimeError contexts with adversarial markers and exercises structure validation, limits materialization, direct construction, retained-byte compilation, private parsing, profile validation and schema-reference validation. It asserts __suppress_context__ is true, __cause__ is None and traceback.format_exception contains no marker.

py312_result_review.note: The earlier R6 py312 launch error was a runner path substitution before pytest started; the retry record uses the actual pinned py312 interpreter and passes.

known_defect_closure: 29 direct private raises now suppress active outer exception context.
48 named pytest helper calls now pass exc.value.
The single profile schema lookup now uses schemas rather than inventory.
boundary: The exact R6 assembled source/test pair is suitable for the next root-owned candidate, installed-wheel and full-regression checks. This review does not accept the candidate, write product paths, or authorize Git/merge/CI actions.
